name: Test Plate Reader Kinetic Schedule
description: Fast smoke test for platereader_run_kinetic_schedule. Uses a 3-read, 2-second kinetic window so simulation completes quickly. If run on real hardware, it assumes the plate reader is already loaded and closed and will execute the underlying Gen5 read/export flow three times.

inputs.name: kinetic_second_read_s
inputs.description: Second read time after kinetic t0; tiny value for smoke test.

inputs.name: kinetic_interval_s
inputs.description: Interval between subsequent reads; tiny value for smoke test.

inputs.name: kinetic_total_time_s
inputs.description: End of kinetic window; default gives reads at 0, 1, and 2 seconds.

inputs.name: reader_equilibration_s
inputs.description: Short equilibration wait before first read.

nodes.label: Run Fast Kinetic Schedule Test
nodes.description: Exercise platereader_run_kinetic_schedule with a minimal 3-read schedule.
